name: Timothy J. Roemer
summary: Timothy John Roemer (born October 30, 1956) is an American diplomat and politician from Indiana who, as a member of the Democratic Party, served in the United States House of Representatives from 1991 to 2003 in Indiana's 3rd congressional district. Subsequently, he was later the president of the Center for National Policy (CNP), a Washington, D.C.–based national security think tank. He served as United States Ambassador to India from 2009 to 2011.
